name: Ray
source:
Ray is an angel with an egotistical streak. He is an extremely skilled fighter who is always on the front lines challenging Lucifer to battle. He doesn’t think about the small things and is a carefree optimist. He is very interested in humans and would like you to take an interest in the Heavenly World.

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.tenshikaigai]Google Play[/url]]
